Thanks Karthik — quick update and proposed manual review steps. I've pulled the CSV and started classification. Preliminary distribution: ~55% formatting/normalization (trim, country code, extra characters), 30% VIES soft-fails, 15% hard-fails (registry mismatch).

Proposed playbook (draft attached: manual_review_playbook_draft.docx):
1) Pre-check normalization: run script to strip spaces, ensure country code prefix, standardize characters. If normalized and passes VIES -> auto-reprocess.
2) VIES soft-fail: retry VIES at 1-hour intervals for up to 3 attempts; if still failing, mark as "manual verification required" and reach out to vendor with template.
3) Hard-fail: create a ‘hold for vendor evidence’ state. Do not release payment. Request VAT certificate or registration portal screenshot. Assign to Finance QA queue for manual verification.
4) Temporary workaround: if vendor provides valid tax registration URL and supporting commercial docs, Finance Ops can issue a provisional release with a note to reverse if later invalidated — only for contracts < $5k.
5) Audit trail: update the shared spreadsheet (link below) with status, verifier initials, evidence link, and ticket id.

Operational asks for Eng/Product: we should be able to tag invoices with "vat_manual_review" to prevent duplicate processing and to bulk re-run normalization once fixes are applied. I'll attach the draft playbook and a spreadsheet to track the 120 rows.

Google Sheet (tracking): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Xy_example_sheetid/edit#gid=0
Attachments: manual_review_playbook_draft.docx
